sources.entry: CCometixLine by Haleclipse - A high-performance Claude Code statusline tool written in Rust with Git integration, usage tracking, interactive TUI configuration, and Claude Code enhancement utilities.

summary.one_liner: CCometixLine (ccline) is a fast Rust status line for Claude Code that shows session, git, quota, cache and cost metrics, with a full-screen terminal configurator.
summary.what_it_does: Renders a configurable status line for Claude Code, reading the session input Claude Code pipes to it. Metrics cover model and reasoning effort, directory, git state, context use and its trend, the 5-hour and weekly limits with a pace bar against elapsed time, prompt cache countdown and hit ratio, cost, and PR and worktree info, with 30+ metrics in total. Items can be shown as text, progress bars, gauges, sparklines or pace bars, with text templates for narrow terminals. A full-screen configurator (Rust TUI) edits layout, style and palettes with a live preview, offers eight presets, and can point Claude Code's settings.json at ccline. A models.toml file sets display names and context windows for third-party models. An optional companion mod adds metrics such as time to first token and running tools, and the same binary can draw a line under background subagents.
use_cases: show model and context usage in the Claude Code status line
track 5-hour and weekly Claude usage limits
display git branch and status while using Claude Code
monitor prompt cache expiry and hit ratio
customize a terminal status bar with a TUI
fix context window size for third-party models in Claude Code
how_to_run: git clone <repo> && cd CCometixLine && cargo build --release
notable: Pace bar for 5-hour and weekly quotas showing usage against elapsed window time
Full-screen configurator with live preview of sample sessions and an icon picker covering Nerd Fonts icons
models.toml registry for correct names and context windows of third-party models
Git and custom commands run in the background, off the render path
Companion mod adds live metrics like time to first token and running tools
caveats: Several metrics need Claude Code 2.1.153 or newer, and some need 2.1.251+ or 2.1.287+ plus the companion mod
Icons, powerline and pill skins need a Nerd Font; otherwise use unicode or ascii glyphs
v2 is a rewrite: it does not read v1 config.toml or themes, and the --theme option and Claude Code patcher were removed
